messages:
lee: quick follow-up from the RFC thread 52 thinking about a 'precision-smoothing proxy' idea to reduce sharp quality cliffs when we route between fp8/int8/int4 lanes. basically blend logits from the high-precision and low-precision variants instead of hard switching.

maya: blend logits how? runtime cost seems like doubling work (run both models)?

lee: can do lightweight: run the chosen low-precision lane as normal, run a tiny high-precision sketch (e.g., 1-2 transformer blocks or a distilled head) only when deg-signal crosses threshold, then compute blended_logits = alpha * hi + (1-alpha) * lo. alpha decays over tokens.

ravi: interesting. alpha schedule is key. propose alpha = min(1, scale * degscore) and then exponential decay per-token so we converge back. want to avoid oscillation.

lee: exact sketch in pseudo: 

```
if degscore > T:
  hi_logits = run(sketch_model, input_prefix)
  alpha0 = clamp((degscore - T) / (1-T), 0, 1)
  for t in range(hysteresis):
    alpha = alpha0 * exp(-t / tau)
    out_logits = alpha * hi_logits[t] + (1-alpha) * lo_logits[t]
else:
  out_logits = lo_logits
```

sophia: two implementation notes: 1) need kv compatibility between sketch_model and primary model so cached keys align; 2) ensure random-seed determinism if we use sampling so evals are reproducible.

pat: ops: sketch_model usage is extra GPU load. we should allow sketch models to be CPU-bound or quantized differently (e.g., int8-distill) and have a separate pool `smoothing-sketch` with low but elastic capacity. tag it in infra.

infra-bot: reminder: if new worker-pool is added, request quota via internal infra ticket 17621.

ravi: evaluation dimension: absolute degscore reduction, token-level unigram/bleu for targeted tasks, p95 latency and tail jitter, and cost-per-1000-tokens delta. Need a shadow harness to compare blended vs hard-switch.

maya: also measure adverse effects: hallucination rate increase or latency-driven timeouts. If blending introduces subtle semantic drifts we must detect.

lee: agreement: default mode is 'off' for existing customers. expose profile flags: smoothing.enabled, smoothing.sketch_model, smoothing.threshold, smoothing.hysteresis_tokens, smoothing.max_budget_per_minute, smoothing.canary_pct.

lee: example JSON profile snippet: 

```
smoothing: {
  enabled: true,
  sketch_model: "sktch-tiny-v1",
  threshold: 0.08,
  hysteresis_tokens: 6,
  tau_ms: 120,
  budget_per_min: 50,
  canary_pct: 5
}
```

sophia: we should pin default tau to something small (e.g., 100ms or 3 tokens) to avoid over-smoothing. also add safety: smoothing.max_alpha to never fully replace low-precision output (avoid full takeover).

ravi: KV note: when sketch_model and primary have mismatched layer counts/shapes, we can't reuse KV. suggestion: run sketch in 'prefix-summary' mode that only re-scores logits from last N tokens without touching long-lived kvs. cheaper and safer.

pat: ops again: add telemetry fields smoothing.triggers, smoothing.avg_alpha, smoothing.latency_overhead_ms, smoothing.cost_delta_usd, smoothing.success_rate. plus alerting if smoothing triggers > X% of requests.

lee: rollout plan: 1) local dev impl + unit tests for blending math, 2) canary on non-prod workload with canary_pct=1, shadow comparison for 24-72h, 3) widen canary and evaluate cost/quality tradeoff, 4) enable per-customer opt-in.

maya: QA: need adversarial prompt set where low-precision fails badly; include failure modes so sketch can show improvements. I'll help curate.

lee: will open PR with schema changes, runtime adapter for blending, and an evaluation checklist. linking infra ticket for pool and quota.

ravi: one more thought: allow blending in two modes: a) corrective (only when degscore high) and b) proactive (blend small alpha always to slightly improve baseline). both useful. must expose in profile.

lee: good call. i'll add smoothing.mode = [corrective|continuous] and default to corrective.

pat: ops-bot note: ensure we can throttle sketch calls by client id to avoid hotspots.

infra-bot: queued infra ticket 17621 created (req for smoothing-sketch pool).

lee: thanks all 52 i'll draft and tag people in PR for review.
